description: Quaternion completion: exp, ln, powf, sqrt, squared, half, inner, outer, divisions, projections, polar decomposition, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions and their inverses

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: quaternion_exp
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: quaternion_ln
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: quaternion_powf
ops.tolerance: ceil(64 + 32 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: quaternion_sqrt
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: quaternion_squared
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: quaternion_half
ops.doc: q.half() = q / 2 (nearest; the oracle floors: 1 ulp)
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: quaternion_inner
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: quaternion_outer
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: quaternion_mul_conj
ops.doc: a * b.conjugate() (the kernel of right_div and /)
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: quaternion_right_div
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
